g.text: STM32G071 - USB-PD policy and power control

g.desc: STM32G071 - USB-PD policy and power control

g.text: STM32G071KBT6N LQFP32: PA8=UCPD1_CC1, PB15=UCPD1_CC2, PB6/PB7=I2C1, PA13/PA14=SWD.

g.desc: STM32G071KBT6N LQFP32: PA8=UCPD1_CC1, PB15=UCPD1_CC2, PB6/PB7=I2C1, PA13/PA14=SWD.

g.text: Source-only power path. UCPD dead-battery pins grounded; disable dead-battery function in firmware.

g.desc: Source-only power path. UCPD dead-battery pins grounded; disable dead-battery function in firmware.

g.text: Boot from flash using option bytes; preserve NRST function. Firmware required; no PD stack is generated here.

g.desc: Boot from flash using option bytes; preserve NRST function. Firmware required; no PD stack is generated here.

g.text: Named nets connect the circuit blocks on this sheet and across the hierarchy.

g.desc: Named nets connect the circuit blocks on this sheet and across the hierarchy.

g.text: Upstream Type-C - USB data UFP / PD source

g.desc: Upstream Type-C - USB data UFP / PD source

g.text: STM32 UCPD negotiates PD and manages data-role swap to UFP while keeping power-source role.

g.desc: STM32 UCPD negotiates PD and manages data-role swap to UFP while keeping power-source role.

g.text: TCPP03 source path: common-source back-to-back FETs. Sink path not fitted. 7 mOhm gives nominal 6 A hardware OCP.

g.desc: TCPP03 source path: common-source back-to-back FETs. Sink path not fitted. 7 mOhm gives nominal 6 A hardware OCP.

g.text: 100 W requires identified 5 A e-marked cable; otherwise cap contract to 3 A. Hardware OVP ceiling ~22 V.

g.desc: 100 W requires identified 5 A e-marked cable; otherwise cap contract to 3 A. Hardware OVP ceiling ~22 V.
